name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Personal attention retains bounded work snapshots, owner-filtered recovery, live authority and separate snapshot/own/action truncation. Only blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivered review takes precedence. Every own queue row and next action also carries whose_move (you, reviewer, coordinator or unknown, relative to the caller) and next, one plain sentence derived only from the validated review state: changes requested is the caller's work until it delivers a revision that supersedes the contribution and answers each item; review and integration are the reviewer's or the coordinator's move; a caller waiting for a person by its own checkpoint is quoted in that checkpoint's words, with the move left open. Items where the move is the caller's sort first and top-level your_move counts them. Other authors flag blocked and in-progress tasks; own comments remain quiet and missing checkpoints leave activity unknown. Flagged in-progress tasks sort first within that priority before the action cap. links.task is the task row; links.brief leads to the actual brief. Reading acknowledges nothing; errors and unknown counts never imply idle.
